item: briefing refresh names a producer that ran 300 s or longer (log + stats), releases the caller's read before the first producer, and a failed cache-warm spec no longer leaves its read open
summary: Measured on the real session_scope session: the pool checkout is back at 0 when the 2nd and 3rd producer start, so the RC2 10-28 bundle's 5,751 s read mark (log 80.6 GB) was ONE step; its producer is unknown because nothing recorded per-producer time. run_all_bounded now logs a WARNING and adds stats[slow_producers] (absent when none) for a producer >= 300 s (one checkpoint cycle); a reading, nothing is stopped. Also one _release_transaction before the first producer, and a _safe_rollback in warm_cache's generic spec-failure branch. Not fixed: a single multi-hour producer is not cut short (USER proposal: per-producer statement deadline + latch check, with a new visible stop reason x12).
